missing-email.title: Login could not be completed
missing-email.reason: We did not receive your email address from the login. This usually happens when you are already logged in to another service with a login method that does not share your email address.
missing-email.instructions: Log out, then log in again with a login method that provides your email address.
missing-email.logout-note: This also logs you out of other services that share the same login. Afterwards you return here and can click "Log in".
missing-email.alternative: You can also log out of the other services yourself, or open the site in a private browser window, and log in from there.
